rooms.name: The Vault
rooms.note: Private room inside the original bank vault, with screen and sound.

rooms.name: Main dining room
rooms.note: A section of the banking hall or the full room. No buyout required.

faq.q: Do my guests choose their own entrée?
faq.a: Yes. Each guest chooses their own main course from the options on your menu, at the table or by pre-order. For larger groups, pre-ordering keeps service moving.

faq.q: What does it cost all in?
faq.a: Menus are priced per guest before tax and gratuity. A 20% gratuity and sales tax are added to the final bill, so an $80 menu comes to about $105 per guest all in, and $65 to about $86.
No. We hold your date without a deposit and ask for the final headcount 24 hours before the event.

faq.q: How does a hosted event work?
faq.a: It is prix-fixe and fully served. You choose a per-guest menu, the owner coordinates your event personally, and setup, service and timing are handled for you. Send the estimate form or call, and we reply with availability and a written proposal.
Yes. Every menu has a vegetarian main course, and gluten-free and other needs are handled on request. Note them in the estimate form or tell us when we speak.

faq.q: How many guests can you host?
faq.a: The Vault, our restored 1920s bank-vault room, seats 12 to 22. Parties of 23 to 100 take the main dining room, with no buyout required. The whole restaurant can also be closed to the public for the evening. Every event menu, from the $35 lunch up, is available in The Vault.

faq.q: What is the difference between an event menu and catering?
faq.a: Event menus are served at the restaurant, in The Vault or the dining room. Catering is family-style trays delivered to your office or venue, ordered from the Catering trays view of this page or through ezCater.

terms.gratuity: A 20% gratuity is added to hosted events.
terms.tax: Sales tax is added at the current South San Francisco rate.
terms.deposit: No deposit is required to hold a date.
terms.headcount: Final headcount is due 24 hours before the event.
terms.ordering: Guests may order at the table, or pre-order for larger groups, which keeps service moving.
